summary: Router 0.36.1 (ADR-0104 proposed): render-env.sh, the root helper that writes the router unit's EnvironmentFile, no longer stops at a missing MQTT_PASSWORD. Traced: the access file is still sourced only after not_router_writable (root owner, not group/other-writable, outside the router's writable paths, symlinks resolved); the store client is reached only after an explicit login step whose HTTP status is reported (no answer / refused / ready); every built-in and EXTRA_SECRET_KEYS name keeps the ADR-0080 name rule before it reaches a URL or the file; every value of every name is refused on CR/LF, now also MQTT_PASSWORD (skipped instead of keeping the old file - no injection path either way); the file is still written through mktemp in the target folder, chgrp skirnir-router + 0640 (0600 without the account) and an atomic rename, and a trap removes the temporary file on every exit. A failed fetch or a source with none of the names keeps the existing file, so an attacker who can only disturb the network can delay but not drop or replace secrets (as with an unreachable store before). New SECRET_SOURCE=file: SECRET_FILE passes the same not_router_writable check, must resolve to a regular file readable by root only (mode & 077), and is parsed line by line with bash read - never sourced or evaluated (test: a $(touch) value is copied raw and nothing runs); only rendered names are taken, invalid lines are reported by line number without content, a name given twice is dropped. The bearer token now goes to curl via stdin (-H @-) instead of argv, removing it from the process list (TM-15). install.sh --without-mqtt only removes python3-paho-mqtt from the apt list and passes --without paho-mqtt to pydeps.py; pydeps can only leave out requirements, refuses unknown names (a typo cannot silently change the plan), and hash-locked installation is unchanged (TM-16). The MQTT check in install.sh runs as root with yaml.safe_load on the root-owned config.yaml and refuses before any change. The router's runtime code is unchanged apart from VERSION; it already gates paho with find_spec (ha.py) and starts the publisher only with mqtt.host (app.py). Unit files, the EnvironmentFile path and the ADR-0073/0086 boundaries are unchanged. Added text names no organisation, host, address or person.

The same 14 tests all fail against the script on origin/main.

limitations: The store client was exercised against a fake store only; that the store answers a missing secret with HTTP 404 is assumed from its API. Any other status is treated as a failed fetch, keeps the existing file and is logged by name and status.
Pre-existing, both sources: a value ending in a backslash makes systemd's EnvironmentFile parser join the next line; that can lose the following key but cannot add a name. Not changed here.
As for the access file, only the file and its own folder are checked for owner and mode, not the folders above SECRET_FILE.
monitoring/render-monitoring.sh is unchanged (it never had the MQTT gate) and still treats a failed fetch like a missing name, which keeps its old file in both cases.
No real systemd, apt or venv run: install.sh was tested in its staging mode (--root, --no-venv); pydeps --without is covered by unit cases.
python test/check_adr_index.py reports non-consecutive numbers on this branch alone, because ADR-0101 to 0103 belong to other open pull requests that merge first; the index table itself is current.
